selection.rule: Fixed before any seed was scored. Gate (G) on the frozen test and human-value-01, old = the deployed encoder models/gidi-finance-v1: (a) test type macro-F1 drop <= 0.01, (b) test target exact drop <= 0.02, (c) human-value-01 debt-only slice (n=13, encoder + unchanged parser) end-to-end exact >= 0.8. The release candidate is seed 1 (deployment convention) unless seed 1 fails G while the three-seed mean passes G; then it is the seed whose test type macro-F1 is the median of the three. Verdict ACCEPT iff the release candidate passes G, else REJECT (a mean that passes with a failing candidate is reported, not accepted).
selection.candidate_reason: seed 1 (deployment convention); it fails the gate and so does the mean
